_doc: Round 5 paint-over for q at 80 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/q_80.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (0, -1), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: brows
layers.why: Q: brows set down toward the centre.

layers.name: eye_far
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan'. At 80 the eye keeps round 4's 3-4 row shape (a 2-row lash block would close it); the palette takes the 144 eye's ramp: D (was #86b8ee cyan) is now the pale desaturated #8ea6d2, B/C the muted blues.
